de: An auto-da-fé, held in the Brasero de la Dehesa outside of Ávila, concludes the case of the Holy Child of La Guardia with the public execution of several Jewish and converso suspects.

dz: 在第九次十字军东征期间出行期间,爱德华王子在英格兰的亨利三世去世后成为了英格兰国王,但他在将近两年的时间里不会回到英格兰来登上王位.
de: While travelling during the Ninth Crusade, Prince Edward becomes King of England upon Henry III of England's death, but he will not return to England for nearly two years to assume the throne.

dz: 南唐皇帝李璟派边镐率领一万人的远征军征服楚国。李璟将楚国统治家族迁至自己的都城南京，楚国至此灭亡。
de: Emperor Li Jing sends a Southern Tang expeditionary force of 10,000 men under Bian Hao to conquer Chu. Li Jing removes the ruling family to his own capital in Nanjing, ending the Chu Kingdom.
